title: Enterprise Connectivity: acceptance undiscounted transfer subtotal
content:
## Application
Enterprise Connectivity applies this acceptance undiscounted transfer subtotal rule to invoice ceiling acceptance.

## Basis: undiscounted subtotal
For invoice ceiling acceptance, subtract the source tier monthly included outbound transfer from that period quantity and floor at zero, then multiply by its standard unit price; this gives the undiscounted transfer subtotal.

## Basis Q&A
| Invoice ceiling acceptance basis | Consequence for this action |
| --- | --- |
| Invoice ceiling acceptance: Subtract the source tier monthly included outbound transfer from that period quantity and floor at zero, then multiply by its standard unit price | this gives the undiscounted transfer subtotal. |

## Hypothetical transfer subtotal
For a hypothetical invoice ceiling acceptance, take monthly volume of 31 GB, included transfer of 20 GB and unit price USD 0.13. The excess is 11 GB, producing an undiscounted subtotal of USD 1.43. A hypothetical volume of 18 GB instead produces zero after the volume floor.
